# EdgeSuite
> Akamai EdgeSuite is Akamai’s edge delivery platform for CDN, DNS, security, and edge application services.

EdgeSuite is associated with Akamai’s delivery and edge infrastructure. Public product, developer, and operational documentation for EdgeSuite-related capabilities is primarily published across Akamai’s documentation, developer, and status properties.

## Platform Documentation
- [Akamai Documentation Home](https://techdocs.akamai.com/): Central documentation hub for Akamai products, services, and platform capabilities.
- [Akamai Developer Home](https://developer.akamai.com/): Developer portal for APIs, tools, workflows, and integration guidance.
- [Akamai Control Center Help](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/page/control-center-help): Documentation for Akamai Control Center configuration and administration.
- [Akamai Product Documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/home/docs): Entry point for product-specific technical documentation and feature guides.
- [Akamai API Overview](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/about-apis): Overview of Akamai APIs, authentication, and usage patterns.

## Delivery and CDN
- [Ion](https://techdocs.akamai.com/ion/docs): Documentation for dynamic site acceleration and performance optimization.
- [Adaptive Media Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/adaptive-media-delivery/docs): Guides for media delivery, streaming, and playback optimization.
- [Download Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/download-delivery/docs): Documentation for large file and software download delivery.
- [Object Delivery](https://techdocs.akamai.com/object-delivery/docs): Configuration guidance for general web object caching and delivery.
- [Image and Video Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/image-and-video-manager/docs): Image and video optimization at the edge.
- [Cloud Wrapper](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloud-wrapper/docs): Multi-CDN traffic management and delivery orchestration documentation.

## DNS and Traffic Management
- [Edge DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edge-dns/docs): Managed authoritative DNS configuration and operational guidance.
- [Global Traffic Management](https://techdocs.akamai.com/gtm/docs): DNS-based traffic steering, failover, and load balancing documentation.
- [Application Load Balancer](https://techdocs.akamai.com/application-load-balancer/docs): Edge-based load balancing for application traffic distribution.
- [Fast DNS](https://techdocs.akamai.com/fast-dns/docs): Documentation for high-performance DNS delivery and management.
- [TrafficPeak](https://techdocs.akamai.com/trafficpeak/docs): Traffic analytics and visibility documentation for DNS and delivery services.

## Security
- [App and API Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/app-api-protector/docs): Web application and API protection configuration and policy guidance.
- [Prolexic](https://techdocs.akamai.com/prolexic/docs): DDoS protection and mitigation documentation.
- [Bot Manager](https://techdocs.akamai.com/bot-manager/docs): Bot detection, mitigation, and management documentation.
- [API Security](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-security/docs): API discovery, risk analysis, and protection guidance.
- [Account Protector](https://techdocs.akamai.com/account-protector/docs): Fraud and account abuse protection documentation.
- [Client-Side Protection and Compliance](https://techdocs.akamai.com/client-side-protection-compliance/docs): Client-side script monitoring and compliance controls.

## Edge Compute and Application Services
- [EdgeWorkers](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs): Serverless edge compute for request and response customization.
- [Cloudlets](https://techdocs.akamai.com/cloudlets/docs): Policy-based edge logic for routing, redirects, and personalization.
- [API Gateway](https://techdocs.akamai.com/api-gateway/docs): API exposure, management, and edge enforcement documentation.
- [MFA for Enterprise](https://techdocs.akamai.com/mfa/docs): Multi-factor authentication deployment and administration guidance.
- [Enterprise Application Access](https://techdocs.akamai.com/eaa/docs): Zero trust application access documentation.

## APIs and Automation
- [Akamai APIs](https://developer.akamai.com/api): Catalog of Akamai APIs for platform automation and integration.
- [OPEN EdgeGrid Authentication](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Set up API credentials and EdgeGrid authentication.
- [Property Manager API](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/property_manager/v1.html): API reference for managing delivery configurations and properties.
- [Edge DNS API](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/edge_dns/v2.html): API reference for DNS zones, records, and configuration.
- [Global Traffic Management API](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/global_traffic_management/v1.html): API reference for GTM domains, properties, and failover settings.
- [Purge API](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/ccu/v3.html): API reference for content invalidation and cache purge operations.
- [EdgeWorkers API](https://developer.akamai.com/api/core_features/edgeworkers/v1.html): API reference for edge compute code deployment and management.

## Developer Tools and SDKs
- [Akamai CLI](https://github.com/akamai/cli): Command-line interface for Akamai APIs and operational workflows.
- [Akamai Terraform Provider](https://github.com/akamai/terraform-provider-akamai): Infrastructure as code provider for managing Akamai resources.
- [EdgeGrid for Go](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-golang): Go library for Akamai OPEN API authentication and requests.
- [EdgeGrid for Python](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-python): Python authentication handler for Akamai OPEN APIs.
- [EdgeGrid for Java](https://github.com/akamai/AkamaiOPEN-edgegrid-java): Java library for signing and sending Akamai API requests.
- [EdgeWorkers Examples](https://github.com/akamai/edgeworkers-examples): Sample EdgeWorkers projects and implementation patterns.

## Guides and Learning
- [Get Started with Akamai APIs](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/get-started-with-akamai-apis): Introductory guide to using Akamai APIs and credentials.
- [Create API Client Credentials](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/set-up-authentication-credentials): Steps to generate and configure API access credentials.
- [Use the Akamai CLI](https://techdocs.akamai.com/developer/docs/cli): Documentation for installing and using the Akamai CLI.
- [EdgeWorkers Getting Started](https://techdocs.akamai.com/edgeworkers/docs/getting-started): First steps for building and deploying edge compute functions.
- [Property Manager Best Practices](https://techdocs.akamai.com/property-mgr/docs): Guidance for configuring and maintaining delivery properties.
- [Purge Content](https://techdocs.akamai.com/purge-cache/docs): Documentation for cache invalidation and content refresh workflows.

- [Akamai Status](https://www.akamaistatus.com/): Service status, incidents, and maintenance updates for Akamai platforms.

- [Akamai Support](https://support.akamai.com/): Customer support portal for cases, diagnostics, and service assistance.
- [Akamai Trust Center](https://www.akamai.com/trust-center): Security, compliance, privacy, and trust information.
- [Akamai System Status FAQ](https://www.akamaistatus.com/): Operational visibility into platform availability and incidents.
